name: Perplexity
description: Perplexity describes itself as an AI answer engine that researches the open web in real time and returns concise, cited answers.
best_for: Perplexity positions itself for people who want real-time, cited answers to questions rather than a list of links — i.e., research/search replacement, with Pro tiers for deeper "Pro Search," file uploads, and Spaces (saved research collections).

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Base search and limited Computer/agent credits.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Per month billed annually. Deep research, access to top AI models, 4,000 bonus Computer credits.

tiers.name: Max
tiers.notes: Per month billed annually. 10,000 monthly Computer credits, frontier AI models, highest usage limits.

cons: Both paid plans are explicitly stated as for personal use only, subject to Perplexity's own policies -- a business/commercial-use buyer should verify current terms before purchasing on a personal card.
Max costs nearly 10x Pro ($167 vs $17/month) for higher usage limits and frontier models, a steep jump with no mid-tier option.
"Computer" (Perplexity's agentic task feature) usage is credit-metered on every tier, including Pro, so heavy use can exhaust the included allowance before the billing period ends.

alternatives.name: ChatGPT
alternatives.description: OpenAI's AI assistant offering chat, voice, vision, and agentic "Work"/"Codex" capabilities.
alternatives.best_for: Users wanting one broad assistant across chat, research, documents, and coding.

alternatives.name: Gemini
alternatives.description: Google DeepMind's family of AI models for building and using intelligent agents across text, image, video, and audio.
alternatives.best_for: Users needing deep research across very large documents/contexts with Search integration.
